RESULT [weeds]: Adding manually selected generated images to real images gave mAP50-95 of 88.3% and mAP50 of 95.0%, gains of 1.4 and 0.8 points over training on real images only. This is from the paper's abstract as indexed; the full text was paywalled.
US [weeds]: The 2021 subset overlaps CottonWeedDet12, so the holdout guard must treat 3SeasonWeedDet10-2021 as a copy of cwd12, not as harvested data. The 2022 and 2023 subsets are a clean cross-season test set for the same species. Diffusion augmentation adds about 1 point and only after manual selection, so synthetic data should go in as a gated, reversible increment.
